articles.summary: Vancouver, British Columbia (June 16, 2026) – Vizsla Silver Corp. (TSX: VZLA) (NYSE: VZLA) (Frankfurt: 0G31) (“Vizsla Silver” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that it has awarded the equipment supply agreement (the “Equipment Supply Agreement”) to FLSmidth (“FLS”) for the Company’s wholly-owned Panuco silver-gold project (“Panuco” or the “Project”) located in Sinaloa, Mexico.
